login.title: Sign in or create an account
login.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a code. No password needed.
login.mockNotice: Offline mode: no email is sent, so you're signed in straight away.
login.demoLoading: Importing sample statements… this takes a few seconds the first time.
login.linkInvalid: That link didn't work. It may have expired or already been used. Enter your email to get a new code.
login.newDescription: There's no account for {email} yet. Tell us your name to create one.
login.name: Your name
login.codeDescription: Enter the {length}-digit code we sent to {email}.
login.codeHelp: Can't find it? Check your spam folder. You can also use the button in the email.
login.resent: We sent you a new code.

confirm.title: Finish signing in
confirm.description: One last step: confirm it's you to continue.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.invitedDescription: Join to see and manage your shared accounts together.
onboarding.setupTitle: Hi {name}, let's set up your household
onboarding.setupDescription: A household holds your accounts and those you share with your partner. You can invite them in the next step.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.invalidTitle: This invitation is no longer valid
invite.invalidDescription: It may have expired or already been used. Ask your partner for a new link.
invite.alreadyMemberDescription: Each person can be in one household. Sign in with another email to accept this invite.
invite.joinDescription: You'll see the household's shared accounts and can upload statements together. Accounts marked private stay private.
invite.wrongEmailTitle: This invitation is for someone else
invite.wrongEmailDescription: You're signed in as {email}, but the invitation was sent to a different address. Sign in with that address to accept it.
